use_scalar_bias_function: use the scalar_bias function to prepend a scalar bias vector to a PyTorch tensor along a specified dimension
apply_scalar_bias_autograd: apply the ScalarBias autograd function to add a learnable scalar bias for self-attention mechanisms in transformer models
review_scalar_bias_forward: review the ScalarBias forward pass that expands input tensor size by one along the specified dimension and fills with bias_init value
test_scalar_bias_backward: test the ScalarBias backward pass that extracts gradients from the input portion of the tensor excluding the bias dimension
refactor_scalar_bias_for_custom_dim: refactor the scalar_bias function to support custom default bias initialization values for different attention scenarios
